_wix_note: Category IDs are pending, not missing by oversight. The Wix Events app on this site enforces a hard 100-category cap and the site already carries 122 real categories (down from 181 after a 2026-09-09 cleanup) - no new category can be created until more room is freed. Board building and curation work fine with null category IDs; only the his-event-drafter Wix-write step is blocked until these are filled in.

sources.name: Oakville Public Library
sources.notes: Communico feed, same platform as Hamilton Public Library - the feed's own `url` field already points at the right host (opl.libnet.info) unlike Hamilton's, but event_url_base is still set explicitly rather than relying on the home-domain default. Carries real newcomer-relevant programming (e.g. 'Settlement Services for Newcomers' seen at Glen Abbey branch). Found 2026-09-09 by trying the <client>.libnet.info/eeventcaldata pattern directly.

sources.name: Milton Public Library
sources.notes: Milton Public Library's real domain is beinspired.ca; events run on Springshare LibCal at beinspired.libcal.com (calendar id 8238, found via the calendar page's own network calls). The /ajax/calendar/list?c=<id>&date=&monthly=true endpoint is public, no key. New generic `libcal` parser added 2026-09-09 - reusable for any future city on this very common library/university platform. Caveat: perpage defaults to 20 and this parser doesn't paginate past that yet, fine for Milton's volume.

sources.name: City of Mississauga Events
sources.notes: Custom public REST API (found via the events-calendar page's own JS, not documented anywhere) covering Celebration Square, Living Arts Centre, farmers markets, festivals. Only /Events/Featured/100 is used - the real /Events/Search endpoint 500s on a bare GET and needs a POST body not yet reverse-engineered, so this is 'featured' events only (~23 at a time), not the full catalog. New `mississauga_events` parser added 2026-09-09.

sources.name: UTM International Education Centre
sources.notes: The public IEC calendar is real but very thin (day-of-month + title only, no time/venue/link per event) - not worth a bespoke scraper. The full system is UofT's 'Folio' platform (folio.utoronto.ca/students/events...), which requires UofT SSO login - not publicly scrapeable at all. Checked 2026-09-09.

sources.name: Sheridan College International Student Services
sources.notes: Sheridan has campuses in Oakville (Trafalgar) and Mississauga (Hazel McCallion) - a natural anchor source, but the international page found 2026-09-09 is admissions-focused, not a current-student events page, and the site isn't WordPress (no wp-json routes at all, tribe or otherwise). Needs the actual current-student events URL found and a feed pattern identified.

sources.name: Polycultural Immigrant & Community Services
sources.notes: Serves Mississauga/Peel newcomers - settlement, employment, language programs. /events 404s and no wp-json/tribe route found 2026-09-09. Needs the real events page URL and a feed pattern identified.

sources.name: Halton Multicultural Council (HMC Connections)
sources.notes: Serves Oakville/Milton/Burlington newcomers - settlement, employment, language programs. Registered domain (haltonmulticultural.org) is genuinely dead (DNS NXDOMAIN, confirmed 2026-09-09) - the org rebranded to HMC Connections at hmcconnections.com. WordPress + The Events Calendar, confirmed live via wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events (252 total events, 84 pages).

sources.name: Town of Milton Events
sources.notes: Registered civic events page (milton.ca/en/things-to-do/events.aspx) 404s - the town restructured to milton.ca/en/arts-and-recreation/events.aspx, which links out to its own calendar.milton.ca subdomain, same eSolutionsGroup/GovStack platform as Brantford/Thunder Bay/Kitchener (see build_board.py's govstack_calendar parser). Confirmed live 2026-09-09 (23 raw events) - Milton's tenant capitalizes /Default/Detail/ where Brantford/Thunder Bay/Kitchener use lowercase, which required making the parser's detail-link match case-insensitive.

sources.name: Town of Oakville Events
sources.notes: Registered civic events page (oakville.ca/townhall/events-calendar.html) 404s - restructured to oakville.ca/calendar/, confirmed live 2026-09-09 (200 OK) but no known-platform marker found on a first pass (not GovStack/tribe/sqs - unlike Milton's calendar.milton.ca, Oakville does not appear to run the same eSolutionsGroup vendor). No feed found; re-probe with a browser render if this city gets a second pass.
